ilanPaketleri.baslangicPaketAciklama: 5 listing credits at a lower per-listing rate.
ilanPaketleri.profesyonelPaketAciklama: 15 listing credits for teams hiring regularly.
ilanPaketleri.kurumsalPaketAciklama: 30 listing credits valid for 90 days. No unlimited usage; costs and hiring volume stay predictable.
